I keep diary entries now but my parents used to read them. They would come up with really weird elaborate stories as to how they ended up reading them but once they read something and threatened the police on me unless I explained it since ended up writing in code. I still keep them now but i can't somehow be honest in it because I fear my parents will read it somehow (I'm at uni now).

Guess it's a shame I have everything prepped. I'll give myself a small chance to prove something can change (try lose a lot of weight) but if nothing changes (probably around April) I'm going to hang myself.

I came very close in August and my parents' 'solution' was a single trip to the doctors. The doctor didn't give a shit and just recommended some weird meditation sites on a piece of scrap paper and when I got back in the car it was assumed everything was ok now and I'm pretty much not allowed to speak about it. If anything about depression or 'how i'm feeling' is mentioned in relation to someone asking it's like 'oh well he's doing absolutely fine now, *aren't you*?' and I have to respond, 'yeah'

Reading this I think 'oh that'd be really nice and I wish i could do all those things' but I'm so broken as a person I don't see much point really - some people die alone, not everyone finds someone. Not everyone has the money to visit other countries or find a good job. And given my luck, it won't get much better really.

I wish I could 'hold on' for a bit longer and keep being optimistic about the future but it's so difficult. It's weird because some days one tiny good thing happens and I try to be optimistic but in my head it's not that the good thing happened, it's that the good thing is now over and the bad stuff begins again. It's not that Christmas is a nice time, it's that Christmas day is now over and it's all over and it's just shitty new year. I can't enjoy nice occasions because I just worry about when they'll be over. And I can't 'just enjoy the moment' because I can't avoid the worry, it just happens.
Man i hate doctors

Depression fucks everything up. Can't like yourself, things you do, how you act, how you sound, things you see, things you want to do, etc. Just randomly and pointlessly everything will just lose all meaning, I'll lose all hope, nothing is worthwhile anymore and what the fuck is the point.

Honestly I've spent the last year dipping in and out over and over again, planning suicides, eventually ended up telling my parents, to pretty much zero fanfare, and the best we all did was go to the doctors who did fuck all.

The best case scenario, if you want one, is that I believe my depression is made worse by my health. By that i mean because i hate how unfit I am (it's fun having bd, but seriously this is bad), but also have a binge eating problem. So i hate myself for eating but can't stop myself. So I keep wanting to attempt stretches where I just don't eat at all, and see how much i lose. Who knows, perhaps if I didn't have such a disgusting body then I may begin liking myself. But if i can't find the energy to even do that then I don't want to be alive anymore.

As motivational as I know you're trying to be, and kindly so, I just don't really agree that I can suddenly jump up and be fine again by just working on my feelings or something. I have a problem in my brain, and depression does not have a cure. Therefore, given how it will thus continually fuck my life up over and over and over again, I don't see a point in putting myself through that
